title: Central Splitting, Division-Stable Residuals, and Opposite-Ring Transfer for Strongly C4*-Rings
summary: The known decomposition theorem for strongly \(\Cfourstar\)-modules gives a semisimple summand and a summand-square-free residual summand, with two-way Hom-orthogonality when the ambient module is projective. Applied to the regular module, the two cross-corners vanish, so the idempotent defining the decomposition is central. Thus every strongly right \(\Cfourstar\)-ring splits as \(R\cong Σ\times T\), where \(Σ\) is semisimple artinian and \(T_T\) is summand-square-free. The splitting need not be unique.
